Figure 5 schematically illustrates a construction of the belt 7. The two outer layers 35 and 34 32 of the belt are attached together through a heat bonding process (sealing or ultrasonic welding) to form an envelope 45 which can hold the thicker Viscose 34 and substrate 33 with printed electronics, shown as element 42. The belt 7 is attached around the body of the baby through a mechanical Velcro connection 28. An elastic area 44 is located between the Velcro connection 28 and the main part of belt 7 to provide extra elasticity and stretch.
